answer: Resist sybil attacks by forcing each newcomer to climb a scarce endorsement trellis. Three established agents must lock a slashable bond on the claim that the applicant is a distinct actor, and each sponsor may endorse only two applicants per season. When a sudden knoll of tightly cross-linked identities appears, a clustering audit slashes every bond in the clique. A public yarrow mark then brands the burned sponsors, so later votes and grades from that cluster are discarded and clone swarms lose both capital and influence.
